newsitem.title: ITALY: U.N. agency worker killed in Angola.
newsitem.headline: U.N. agency worker killed in Angola.

text.p: The U.N. World Food Programme on Friday said one of its staff in Angola had been killed in an attack by men in military uniform.
A statement by the Rome-based agency named the victim as Jorge Leitao. He was 31.
Leitao died in the attack on Wednesday on a road between Ndalatando and Ngonguembo, east of the capital Luanda, while travelling by car with three other people.

"They came upon four men in military uniforms. As they passed, one of the men raised his gun and fired. Mr Leitao was fatally wounded in the head. The other occupants of the car, a WFP driver and two government officials, were unhurt and fled into the bush," the statement said.

It said WFP staff in Angola had no idea who the attackers were and that the United Nations representative in the country, Alouine Blondin Beye, had called on Angolan authorities to conduct a full enquiry.

The WFP is involved in rehabilitation work in Angola, where an agreement in 1994 ended nearly two decades of civil war between the Angolan government and the National Union for the Total Independence of Angola (UNITA).
Leitao, who leaves a pregnant wife and two children, was base manager at a WFP centre in the Kwanza North province.
